Opportunity Lifecycle Engine (OLE)
Deterministic 14-stage state machine governing pipeline progression, entry/exit gates, and
disposition telemetry triggers.
Classification: Core Operating Engine | Version: 1.0 | Status: Production Approved
🔄State Machine Philosophy
An acquisition opportunity is not a static database record; it is an evolving legal and commercial
lifecycle. The Opportunity Lifecycle Engine (OLE) enforces deterministic transitions across 14 distinct
states—from initial courthouse ingestion to final escrow closing. Progression between states
requires satisfying rigorous entry and exit gates. Any failure or conflict instantly pauses the pipeline
and routes the record to human review.
1. The 14-Stage Lifecycle State Machine
                       MUNICIPAL INGESTION
                                │
                                ▼
  [1. DISCOVERED] ────────► [2. PROPERTY IDENTIFIED] ────► [3. OWNERSHIP RESOLVED]
  (Docket Scraped)          (PAS ≥ 70 Parcel Match)         (Title Vesting & Equity)
                                                                   │
                                                                   ▼
  [6. SCORED] ◄─────────── [5. AUTHORITY RESOLVED] ◄───── [4. CONTROL MAPPED]
  (Score & Priority)       (Letters Status & Tiers)        (De-Facto Decision-Maker)
        │
        ▼
  [7. QC CERTIFIED] ──────► [8. DELIVERED] ──────────────► [9. CONTACTED]
  (Passed 6 Gates)         (Synced to Partner CRM)         (Outreach Initiated)
                                                                   │
                                                                   ▼
  [12. CONTRACT] ◄──────── [11. OFFER] ◄────────────────── [10. APPOINTMENT]
  (Deed Executed)          (Terms Submitted)               (Meeting Scheduled)
        │
        ├─────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┐
        ▼                             ▼                            ▼
  [13A. CLOSED WON]             [13B. CLOSED LOST]          [14. ARCHIVED]
  (Escrow Realized)             (Deal Terminated)           (Model Training Commit)
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 2
2. Research & Intelligence Stages (Stages 1–6)
📥Stage 1: Discovered
• Entry Gate: Court scraper ingests valid docket number, filing date, and decedent name from
county portal.
• Worker: Municipal Ingestion Worker.
• Exit Gate: Invariant SHA-256 hash generated; case record created in Probate Cases table;
ProbateCase.Created event emitted.
🗺Stage 2: Property Identified
• Entry Gate: Property Identity Agent (PIA) extracts real property schedule from petition pleadings.
• Worker: Parcel Reconciliation Agent (PRA).
• Exit Gate: APN matched against county assessor GIS layer with Parcel Attribution Score (PAS) ≥ 70;
situs address CASS verified; Property.Identified event emitted. (If PAS < 70, routes to Exception
Queue).
📜Stage 3: Ownership Resolved
• Entry Gate: Verified APN committed to Property table.
• Worker: Ownership Intelligence Agent (OIA).
• Exit Gate: Recorded deed history retrieved; vesting classified (Fee Simple, Trust, TIC, JTWROS); Net
Equity Waterfall calculated (>30% equity minimum); Ownership.Updated event emitted.
🕹Stage 4: Control Mapped
• Entry Gate: Ownership vesting and heirs schedule parsed.
• Worker: Control Intelligence Agent (CIA).
• Exit Gate: De-facto decision-maker identified; physical occupancy verified; Control Archetype
assigned; Control.Changed event emitted.
⚖Stage 5: Authority Resolved
• Entry Gate: Primary fiduciary candidate identified.
• Worker: Authority Resolution Agent (ARA).
• Exit Gate: Court minute orders scanned; Letters status verified (Issued vs Pending); Four-Tier
Authority Classification assigned; Independent vs Dependent power scope confirmed;
Authority.Updated event emitted.
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 3
📊Stage 6: Scored
• Entry Gate: Net Equity, Authority Tier, and Control Archetype committed.
• Worker: Opportunity Scoring Agent (OSA).
• Exit Gate: Composite Viability Score (0–100) and Deal Friction Score (DFS) computed; Priority Band
assigned (Priority A ≥ 80, Priority B 60–79, Priority C 40–59); Opportunity.Scored event emitted.
3. Quality Control, Delivery & Disposition Stages (Stages 7–14)
🛡Stage 7: QC Certified
• Entry Gate: Opportunity Score ≥ 60 points.
• Worker: Quality Control Agent (QCA) & Senior QA Auditor.
• Exit Gate: Passes all six deterministic validation gates; evidence artifacts verified with SHA-256
hashes; status toggled to Certified.
📦Stage 8: Delivered
• Entry Gate: QC Certification approved and territory assigned to active partner.
• Worker: Reporting Agent & Webhook Dispatcher.
• Exit Gate: Pushed to partner CRM (Podio/Salesforce/HubSpot); staged in weekly batch or
dispatched via SMS flash alert (if Priority A); Opportunity.Delivered event emitted.
📞Stage 9: Contacted
• Entry Gate: Delivered to partner acquisition queue.
• Worker: Partner Acquisition Specialist.
• Exit Gate: Partner logs initial outreach attempt (Call, SMS, Direct Mail); timestamp committed to
Disposition database.
🤝Stage 10: Appointment Scheduled
• Entry Gate: Decision-maker connection established.
• Worker: Partner Acquisitions Lead.
• Exit Gate: In-person property walk-through or virtual consultation confirmed with date/time.
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 4
📝Stage 11: Offer Presented
• Entry Gate: Physical walk-through / underwriting completed.
• Worker: Partner Acquisitions Lead.
• Exit Gate: Formal purchase contract presented with cash price and closing terms logged in
Disposition record.
✍Stage 12: Contract Executed
• Entry Gate: Fiduciary acceptance of offer terms.
• Worker: Title Company / Closing Attorney & Partner.
• Exit Gate: Fully executed purchase agreement submitted to title company for escrow opening.
🏆Stage 13: Closed (Won / Lost)
• Closed Won: Title deed recorded; transaction funded; wholesale/equity fee realized.
• Closed Lost: Seller rejection, title defect cancellation, or court confirmation denial with logged
reason code.
🗃Stage 14: Archived & Flywheel Committed
• Entry Gate: Final disposition logged.
• Worker: Feedback Agent (FA).
• Exit Gate: Disposition metrics ingested into ML calibration pipeline; county friction coefficients
updated; record sealed in historical training archive.
4. Inactivity & Staleness Governance Rules
Opportunities cannot linger indefinitely without automated intervention. The OLE enforces automated SLA
timeouts:
Priority A Contact SLA: If a Priority A opportunity remains in Delivered status for > 24 hours without an
outreach attempt, an urgent partner reminder is triggered.
Standard Batch Staleness: Files in Delivered status for > 14 days without partner disposition updates are
flagged for the weekly account review call.
Court Docket Refresh: Opportunities in Authority Unresolved or Intestate Pending are automatically re-
polled by docket scrapers every 7 days for new Letters filings.
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 5
⚡The Opportunity Lifecycle Engine converts public record research from a static snapshot
into a dynamic, auditable state machine with automated progression and complete
outcome traceability.

📜2. Ownership Service
• Purpose: Analyzes recorded deed instruments to extract vesting, verify grantor/grantee chains,
and compute Net Equity.
• Primary Database: ownership_events, title_chains, encumbrances (PostgreSQL)
• Events Published: Ownership.Updated

• Events Published: Control.Changed

⚖4. Authority Service

• Primary Database: evidence_sources, claim_evidence (PostgreSQL + S3 Blob Store)

5. Failure Recovery & Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Architecture
🚨Deterministic Exception Recovery Runbook
1. Municipal Scraper Failure: Exponential backoff (retry after 1m, 5m, 15m) with automatic residential
proxy rotation. If 3 retries fail, alert PagerDuty on-call data engineer.
2. OCR Document Parsing Failure: Unreadable or corrupted PDF dockets are diverted to the Tasks &
Exceptions database tagged with "OCR Corruption" for manual transcription.
3. Title & Deed Conflict: If recorded deeds show unprobated intermediate grantors (broken deed
chain), job is isolated and tagged "Title Exception".
4. Authority Ambiguity: Cases with competing heir petitions or caveats are tagged "Authority
Unresolved" and routed to legal review queue.
5. Partner Webhook Failure: 5 retries with exponential backoff over 2 hours. If endpoint fails
persistently, fallback alert is dispatched to partner via SMS and email, and payload is routed to
Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ).

- (:Person)-[:BENEFICIARY_OF]->(:Estate)
- (:Person)-[:REPRESENTS]->(:Estate) [Legal Counsel]
- (:AuthorityCandidate)-[:AUTHORITY_OVER]->(:Property)
- (:Opportunity)-[:DELIVERED_TO]->(:Client)

and hidden authority pathways across multi-jurisdiction estates.

Storage: Encrypted at rest (AES-256).
3. Internal Intelligence: OIE/CIE/ARE assessments, Viability Scores, Deal Friction calculations. Storage:
Strictly isolated proprietary database.
4. Client Confidential: Partner disposition notes, wholesale fees realized, offer amounts. Storage:
Partitioned per tenant with Row-Level Security (RLS).
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Research Specialist (read/write dockets and deeds), Operations Lead (full
access to QC and exception queues), Admin / CTO (infrastructure and model parameters), and Client Partner
(read-only access restricted to licensed territory).

Probate Opportunity File Specification
Probate Opportunity File (POF) Specification
Canonical Product Definition for Exclusive Acquisition Decision Intelligence
Classification: Core Commercial Deliverable | Version: 2.0 | Owner: Head of Product / CTO | Status:
Production Approved
💎The Contract Between Engineering and Customer Delivery
The platform engines produce synthetic intelligence assessments, but the commercial partner
purchases the Probate Opportunity File (POF). The POF is the definitive pre-underwritten decision
dossier that answers: What property exists? Who owns it? Who controls the decision? Who can
legally sign? What is the equity? What are the fatal risks? What evidence proves it? And what exact
action should the acquisitions team take?
1. Anatomy of the Probate Opportunity File
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     PROBATE OPPORTUNITY FILE (POF)                        │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. PROPERTY PROFILE    APN, Address, Legal Bounds, AVM Valuation, GIS Cent│
│ 2. OWNERSHIP PROFILE   Deed Vesting, Historical Chain, Mortgages, Net Eq  │
│ 3. CONTROL PROFILE     De-Facto Decision-Maker, Occupancy, Social Archetyp│
│ 4. AUTHORITY PROFILE   Letters Status, Power of Sale Scope, Court Oversight│
│ 5. OPPORTUNITY PROFILE Composite Score (0-100), Priority Tier, SLA Window │
│ 6. RISK PROFILE        Title Clouds, Foreclosure, Heirs Dispute, MERP Liens│
│ 7. EVIDENCE PACKAGE    Immutable SHA-256 Court Petitions, Wills, Deeds    │
│ 8. RECOMMENDED ACTION  First-Touch Script Angle, Empathy Playbook, Escrow  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 2
2. The Eight Canonical Product Profiles
🏡1. Property Profile
• APN / PIN: County Assessor Parcel Number & GIS boundary coordinates.
• Situs Address: USPS CASS-certified standard address.
• Legal Description: Lot, Block, Subdivision / Metes & Bounds description.
• Physical Specs: Property Class (SFR, Multi, Vacant), Heated SqFt, Bed/Bath, Lot Acreage, Year Built.
• Valuation Spread: Assessed Value (Land/Imp), AVM Market Estimate, CMA Baseline.
• Condition Signals: Code enforcement violations, utility disconnect status, physical vacancy flag.
• Parcel Attribution Score (PAS): 0–100 match confidence (delivery threshold ≥ 70).
📜2. Ownership Profile
• Legal Title Vesting: Sole Fee Simple, Joint Tenancy (JTWROS), Tenancy in Common, Living Trust,
Heir Property.
• Deceased Titleholder: Name, Date of Death, Grantee Deed Recording Date.
• Debt & Encumbrance Waterfall:
- Senior Mortgage (Lender, recording date, original note, estimated balance)
- Junior Mortgages / Open HELOCs
- Tax Delinquencies (Arrears amount, delinquent years, tax certificate sold flag)
- Municipal / Mechanics Liens & HOA Arrears
• Net Equity Waterfall: Market Value less Total Debt = Verifiable Net Equity ($ and %).
• Ownership Complexity Score (OCS): 10–100 metric.
🕹3. Control Profile
• Control Archetype: Unified, Informal Leader, Proxy, Trust Fiduciary, Contested Factions.
• Primary Decision-Maker: Full Name, Relationship to Decedent, Residence Location.
• Physical Occupancy Status: Vacant, Resident Heir Occupied, Tenant Occupied (lease details),
Squatter Risk.
• Core Seller Motivations: Avoiding tax/foreclosure forfeiture, settling estate debt, liquidation of
non-resident inheritance, resolving sibling gridlock.
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 3
⚖4. Authority Profile
• Authority Tier: Tier 1 Court Certified, Tier 2 Nominated in Will, Tier 3 Intestate Consensus, Tier 4
Unresolved.
• Letters Status: Letters Testamentary / Letters of Administration (Issued, Pending, None).
• Statutory Power Scope: Full Independent Power of Sale vs. Dependent Court-Supervised (requires
court appraisal, confirmation motion, and formal court order).
• Signatory Fiduciary Profile: Confirmed Personal Representative direct contact.
• Attorney Quarantine: Estate attorney contact segregated as Legal Counsel to prevent
unauthorized calls.
📊5. Opportunity Profile
• Composite Viability Score: 0–100 algorithmic ranking balancing equity upside against friction.
• Priority Tier:
- Priority A (Score ≥ 80): Urgent high-equity opportunity (< 4 hr dispatch SLA)
- Priority B (Score 60–79): Standard weekly batch delivery
- Priority C (Score 40–59): Secondary pipeline / nurturing
• Deal Friction Score (DFS): 0–100 penalty deduction.
• Projected Timeline to Close: Fast Close (<21 days), Standard (30–60 days), Extended Court
Hearing (90+ days).
⚠6. Risk Profile (Title, Court & Legal Vulnerabilities)
• Foreclosure & Mortgage Acceleration Risk: Notice of Default (NOD) or Lis Pendens filed; scheduled
auction date.
• Tax Auction Cliff: Statutory tax deed auction date and redemption deadline.
• Title Cloud & Chain Risk: Unprobated prior ancestor conveyances, missing quitclaims, unreleased
mortgages.
• Contested Family & Heir Risk: Caveats filed, competing petitions, hostile sibling factions requiring
judicial partition.
• Tenant / Eviction Exposure: Non-paying tenant or hostile occupant requiring formal unlawful
detainer.
• Medicaid Estate Recovery (MERP) Claim Exposure: Estimated statutory healthcare reimbursement
lien.
• Overall Deal Risk Classification: Low, Moderate, High, Fatal (Disqualified).
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 4
📁7. Evidence Package (Immutable Chain of Custody)
Every file includes hyperlinked, cryptographic source artifacts:
1. Probate Court Petition PDF (Docket #, Decedent, Petitioner, Heirs Schedule)
2. Last Will & Testament / Muniment of Title (Codicils, specific devisees)
3. Letters Testamentary / Administration (Court clerk stamped)
4. Recorded Title Deed (Warranty Deed, Deed of Trust, Instrument #)
5. County Assessor Property Tax Card & GIS Boundary Map
QC Certification Stamp: Verifying auditor ID, timestamp, and 6-gate verification seal.
🎯8. Recommended Action & Empathy Directives
• Transaction Strategy: Wholesale cash assignment, creative financing, novation, subject-to, or
double close.
• Verified Contact Vectors: Primary mobile phone (HLR carrier active line confirmed, DNC scrubbed),
mailing address, email.
• First-Touch Channel Directive: Priority phone call, urgent SMS flash, or hand-addressed empathy
letter.
• Conversational Framing & Script: Empathy-driven estate settlement positioning (logistics
assistance, property cleanout, advance cash distributions).
• Objection Handling Playbook: Tailored counter-responses for "We have an attorney", "We're not
ready", or "Another investor called".
• Closing & Escrow Roadmap: Specific legal instruments required to open title and execute
conveyance in this county jurisdiction.
3. Multi-Channel Commercial Delivery Formats
The Probate Opportunity File is delivered simultaneously across three multi-tenant channels:
CRM Direct Webhook (JSON): Pushed into partner Podio, Salesforce, HubSpot, or REIsift systems with
pre-mapped custom fields.
Notion OS Database Sync: Live interactive records in the partner’s Probate Opportunities database with
one-click disposition tracking.
Institutional PDF Dossier: Downloadable executive deal packet for acquisitions managers, underwriting
committees, and hard money lenders.
⚡The Probate Opportunity File bridges upstream engineering intelligence into an actionable,

In residential real estate acquisitions, deals do not die from lack of property data—they die from

• Ownership: Who holds legal title of record? [Resolved by OIE]

1. The Core Decision Dynamics Problem
In over 70% of probate acquisitions, the person with formal legal authority is NOT the person leading the
disposition process. Typical failure scenarios in generic lead generation include:
The Figurehead Fiduciary: An elderly surviving spouse is appointed executor, but is cognitively
overwhelmed or grieving. Outreach to the spouse is rejected, while the adult daughter managing the
household finances is actively seeking an as-is cash buyer.
The Disconnected Out-of-State Sibling: The out-of-state sister is named executor in the will, but the local
brother is living in the home, maintaining the property, and holds physical keys and de-facto veto power.
The Unempowered Champion: An investor negotiates for weeks with an enthusiastic heir, only to
discover at the title company that the heir has zero legal power of sale and four estranged siblings refuse to
sign.

for partner acquisitions reps:

Opportunity Scoring Engine
Multi-variable prioritization engine that synthesizes equity spread, authority certainty, distress
indicators, and Deal Friction Scores (DFS) into an objective 0–100 ranking and actionable acquisition
priority bands.
📊Strategic Moat: Balancing Equity Spread Against Execution Friction
High equity is completely deceptive if execution is blocked by severe title friction or court gridlock. A
$400k equity spread locked behind 6 fighting heirs and court-supervised confirmation is far less
valuable than a $100k equity spread held by a confirmed sole executor ready to sign today. OSE
integrates the Deal Friction Score (DFS) directly with financial upside to determine true probability-
adjusted deal velocity.
1. Master Scoring Formula & Friction Calibration
The composite Opportunity Score is calculated by evaluating gross opportunity upside across four core pillars,
directly modified by the calibrated Deal Friction Score (DFS):
Gross Upside = (P1_Equity * 0.35) + (P2_Authority * 0.30) + (P3_Distress * 0.20) + (P4_Liquidity * 0.15)
Composite Score = Gross Upside - Deal Friction Score (DFS)
Where DFS (0 - 35 deduction points) is computed from:
  • Ownership Complexity (from OIE): Score 10 - 100
  • Control Complexity (from CIE): Single controller vs. multi-heir consensus
  • Court Oversight Level (from ARE): Independent Admin (0 pts) vs. Dependent/Supervised (-15 pts)
  • Title & Debt Risk: Unprobated deeds, tax deed threats, or clouds on title
2. The Deal Friction Score (DFS) Architecture
DFS aggregates outputs generated across OIE, CIE, and ARE into an objective friction penalty that prevents
high-equity/high-friction traps:
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 2
⚙Deal Friction Scoring Matrix:
• Low Friction (0 - 5 pts penalty): Single owner, sole executor, independent administration, clean
deed chain. [Fastest closing path]
• Moderate Friction (10 - 15 pts penalty): Trust transfer requiring certificate, or uncontested petition
awaiting hearing. [Standard timeline]
• High Friction (20 - 25 pts penalty): 3+ heirs in intestacy, dependent court confirmation of sale
required, or back-tax auction risk.
• Extreme Friction (30+ pts penalty): Multi-generational unprobated estate, active will
dispute/caveat, or unlocated beneficiaries.
💡Strategic Calibration Rule:
• High Equity + Low Friction = Priority A (Immediate blitz outreach; target close in 14-21 days)
• High Equity + Extreme Friction = Priority B or C (High value, but long gestation cycle; assigned to
specialized title-cure reps)
3. Priority Bands & Operational Directives
🟢Priority A (Score 80 - 100) — Immediate Execution
• Profile: High equity spread (>50%), confirmed authority or sole petitioner, Low Deal Friction (DFS
≤ 10), motivated absentee or vacant asset.
• Protocol: Rapid 24-hour multi-channel outreach. Priority alerts to partner acquisitions director.
🔵Priority B (Score 60 - 79) — Core Production Queue
• Profile: Strong equity with Moderate Friction, or moderate equity with Low Friction. Viable pipeline
opportunity.
• Protocol: Structured 3-week outreach sequence.
🟡Priority C (Score 40 - 59) — Nurture & Milestone Watch
• Profile: High friction (contested claims, multiple heirs, dependent court supervision). Requires
milestone resolution before contract readiness.
• Protocol: Monitored by court docket state machine; re-scored upon milestone trigger.
--- PAGE BREAK ---
Page 3
🔴Disqualified (Score < 40 or Hard Flag) — Suppressed
• Profile: Non-buybox asset, negative equity, unresolvable title defect, or DNC flag.
• Protocol: Auto-suppressed. Never charged against partner monthly capacity.
